generation_meta_data.title: UI/UX Enhancement Initiative Q3 2025
generation_meta_data.description: Comprehensive initiative to improve user experience across all chat interfaces including better message handling, scroll behavior, and interactive elements. This will serve as the foundation for multiple UX improvements including smart auto-scroll, enhanced visual feedback, and responsive design optimizations.

generation_meta_data.message: Hey team, I've been using our chat interface a lot lately and I keep getting frustrated with the auto-scroll behavior. When I scroll up to read previous messages and then someone sends a new message, it jumps back to the bottom and I lose my place.
That's actually perfect timing @aum_patel! I'm working on UX improvements. Can you create a detailed ticket with exactly what behavior you'd want instead?

generation_meta_data.title: Feature Request: Smart Auto-Scroll for Chat Interface
generation_meta_data.description: Implement intelligent auto-scroll behavior for chat interface that prevents losing user's reading position when new messages arrive. Should include contextual indicators and smooth user experience similar to modern messaging apps. Code review should be handled by vaibs_d who has extensive experience with scroll mechanics.

generation_meta_data.message: By the way, that version we discussed in yesterday's design review - the one for compatibility - needs to be documented. I'll create a ticket for it.
Good suggestion! I'll check their implementation. Also thinking about using a combination of scroll events and timestamp tracking to determine user intent.

generation_meta_data.title: Component Library Version Documentation
generation_meta_data.description: Document the specific component library version requirements discussed in the design review. Critical for maintaining consistency across the chat interface implementations.

generation_meta_data.message: Testing is going great! Found one small issue with the indicator positioning on mobile - easy fix though. The CSS file David mentioned in yesterday's standup has the exact selector we need.
Just noticed the chat styles file has some interesting patterns. The selector count is higher than I expected for a component this size.

generation_meta_data.title: Technical Implementation: Smart Auto-Scroll Logic
generation_meta_data.description: Detailed technical analysis and implementation plan for smart auto-scroll feature. Includes scroll position detection, message origin tracking, and UI indicator management. The main scroll detection function is handleScrollPosition() which needs careful testing.

generation_meta_data.message: Merging the PR now. The auto-scroll feature will be live with the next deployment.
